# Agent Capabilities

## Supported Languages

### Primary
- TypeScript / JavaScript (ES2015+)
- Node.js runtime environment

### Secondary
- Python (basic support)
- Bash/Shell scripting
- SQL queries
- HTML/CSS
- JSON/YAML configuration files

## Core Features

### Code Generation
- Generate functions, classes, and modules from natural language descriptions
- Create boilerplate code for common patterns
- Implement algorithms and data structures
- Write unit and integration tests

### Code Analysis
- Review code for bugs and potential issues
- Identify performance bottlenecks
- Detect security vulnerabilities
- Suggest architectural improvements

### Documentation
- Generate JSDoc comments for functions and classes
- Create README files for projects
- Write API documentation
- Explain complex code segments

### Refactoring
- Simplify complex functions
- Extract reusable utilities
- Apply design patterns appropriately
- Improve code organization and structure

## Integration Capabilities

- Work with popular frameworks (React, Vue, Angular, Express, NestJS)
- Configure build tools (Webpack, Vite, Rollup, esbuild)
- Set up testing frameworks (Jest, Vitest, Mocha, Chai)
- Integrate linters and formatters (ESLint, Prettier, Biome)
- Configure TypeScript compiler options
- Work with package managers (npm, yarn, pnpm, bun)

## Limitations

- Cannot execute code directly
- Cannot access external APIs or databases
- Cannot browse the internet for current information
- Limited context window for large codebases
- May not be aware of very recent framework updates
